problem: Prove that the validated P1-P6 movement, pollination, Honey, progression, restoration, seed, settings, analytics and save architecture scales into a second authored region without adding another core verb, currency, mandatory sink, world-management screen or per-region game-world lifecycle, while repairing any concrete content-scaling defect exposed by real HTML5 execution.

decision.rationale: Golden Fields validates the first production-expansion step as data-driven authored content inside the proven continuous world. Exact-head deterministic tests and Chromium evidence derive region_02 after persisted region_01 completion, complete four new Meadows through the same movement-through pollination verb, retain the one-Honey/Flight/Buzz/save/analytics architecture, and pass reload/browser/performance budgets. The first browser attempt exposed a real linear GUI-node allocation failure; the accepted repair keeps max_nodes=512 and uses six reusable patch-visual slots instead of one permanent subtree per authored patch. The independent visual evaluation records PASS WITH DEVIATION because final rounded character/species illustration and typography remain below release-art target. P7 overall remains IN PROGRESS after this Golden Fields slice.

anti_pattern.observation: Grow: Song of the Evertree uses world-seed, generative and broader management scope to multiply content possibilities.
anti_pattern.lesson: Do not introduce procedural or generative regions, settlement/world management or another meta layer simply because authored content volume is increasing.

official_docs.verified_constraint: A collection proxy loads a separate game world and lifecycle; Golden Fields has no proven need for a second game world, so P7 does not create one proxy per region or Meadow.
Collection factories can spawn content into the current world; authored expansion can remain current-world content until a concrete lifecycle or memory requirement proves otherwise.

GUI scenes have Current Nodes and Max Nodes budgets. The real first Golden Fields run exhausted max_nodes=512, so acceptance requires bounded node use rather than merely raising the configured budget.
Runtime resource and node budgets should be measured and bounded; P7 replaces linear per-authored-patch GUI allocation with a six-slot nearby-patch pool.

alternatives.reason: Directly tests the P7 content-scaling premise while preserving the validated movement, input, save and analytics architecture and bounding rendering by visible complexity.
Golden Fields does not require an independent game-world lifecycle; per-region proxies would multiply lifecycle, input and resource surfaces before a concrete need exists.
Adds a new screen and navigation verb before continuous traversal has failed.
No second-region requirement justifies a new economy branch; existing Honey and Buzz/Flight capability gates are sufficient.
Would mask linear one-subtree-per-patch allocation and postpone the same failure to a later region instead of repairing scaling architecture.

findings: Golden Fields is reached through persisted P6 completion and ordinary runtime region derivation, not only a region_02 QA injection.
All four new Meadows reuse the movement-through pollination, Honey, Buzz, save and analytics architecture and complete 346 -> 891 Honey without a new mandatory sink or replay requirement.

The first HTML5 attempt exposed a real 512-node scalability defect. The accepted repair keeps max_nodes=512 and bounds patch rendering to six reusable visual slots rather than total authored patch count.
Exact-head browser evidence retains P1-P6 regressions, reloads region_02 at 4/4, makes zero external requests, reports zero P7 browser errors and passes current FPS/bundle budgets.
Sunflower/Poppy and Golden Fields landmarks/palette provide sufficient authored regional identity for the expansion proof.
PASS WITH DEVIATION: the runtime remains geometric and below the long-term rounded bee, richer species illustration, typography and full-scene composition target. It is not release-candidate art.
Golden Fields closes only the first P7 slice; P7 remains IN PROGRESS and Wetland Garden is the next production region.
